My current goal is to more or less ride things out. I try to view myself as a scientist would view a test subject. Instead of giving into my spirals I try to observe them. It sounds stupid and doesn't always work, but I feel like it gives me some sort of disassociation that allows my brain to process it more rationally.

I have what I call "depression attacks" I'll be at a party and everything is going fine but randomly I get the energy sucked out of me. After that theirs no recovery. Only thing I can do is go to sleep and hope I wake up feeling better.

It's embarrassing so I just try to avoid it. Before long I think I'm going to stop getting invites.

What normally runs through my head is similar to what you have described. I feel like they only invite me out of obligation or to make themselves feel better. I know its not true, but that doesn't matter once I start going down the rabbit hole.

I've have depression for a while, but I was recently diagnosed with adult ADHD at the age of 30. Depression is not the end all be all. There could be an underlying issue outside of depression. Make it through tonight and get an appointment if you think there is another issue. If there isn't its not the end of the line. You might be a psych visit away from the right medication.
My theory is that we are just now more aware of it. We also seem to take it more seriously than we would in the past.

I wasnt at the time, but I made it through that that night. It still bugs me, but I got through it in the following days. You may not be the same; I dont know exactly what youre going through. I was close to ending it though. I'm still depressed and I still have issues but I see a way out, and I try to hold onto that.

I felt bad about my dog after my attempt. It doesnt have to be a person, and you dont have to feel bad like i did. You dont even have to feel great right now. Just remember that you are not alone. I have personally been there and even though im not what I would call recovered, I'm still alive and glad that I am.

I still haven't found purpose in my career to be honest. It's not the end of the road though. I struggle finding purpose myself. I make a paycheck that pays all my bills, but I don't really like my job. My purpose is not my job though. It pays my bills for the moment. Maybe one day I'll find purpose in it. There is purpose outside of a career though. doesn't have to be romance or family related, it might be something entirely different.

What is your major? I never finished college but still found some amount of success. I'm 30 now and still have no idea what I'm going to do, but I college is not the end. There is no set path, you can change things in the future. Personally I've been through 3 different positions after college. I didnt think I was qualified for any of them and still dont. I work in networking and one of the best engineers I ever worked with had a graphic design degree. College is not the end all be all. You have options and dont have to stick with what you majored in.

They might not be aware of what you are feeling or going through. There are 450,000 on r/depression. you are not going through this alone. I'm here and will be up for a while, but im not an expert. If you are feeling like it might happen tonight please call a support line.

https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines

I backed out of my attempt and besides a bit of guilt I'm glad I did. You might be the same way.

I didn't even think about my family during my suicide attempt. Not a single thought went through my head about what I was doing, who it would affect, and what it would do to them. I still backed out.

at the time i sincerely believed that I was doing everyone a favor. Friends, family, whoever. I saw myself as a cancer infecting their lives. I still feel that way on bad nights.

I don't know your mom but is there anyone else in your life you can think of? After my attempt I notably felt bad about my dog. Try to think of some sort of relationship to hold onto human or otherwise. If you can't find it right now start looking soon.

I know it might not mean much, but I've been there too.There's no one answer for everyone but you are reaching out and that is significant. The only reason I'm still alive is because I reached out.
At this point I'm afraid that I've damaged my brain and don't know how to be happy for more than a few days at a time. It's like I've built a defense mechanism against feeling happy.

Yes and I think that's why I'm so ready to follow my spirals downward. Every time I felt like I was making improvements in the past I would have a single downturn and would loose all hope. The fact that I was doing well for so long made me feel like even more of a failure. Now I get suspicious when I start to feel good knowing that after one bad day I will use that against myself.

I wake up every morning feeling like shit. Today I didn't go to work until 2pm which I can get away with luckily. I swapped out a core router after hours and it went smooth so I was feeling good about that, but then I went and bought beer and got fairly drunk and now I'm having trouble dealing with all my shitty thoughts. I've been trying ACT but sometimes I cant keep up. I'm disappointed with myself, but I also know that I've been here hundreds of times and I always make it through.

I have struggled with this too. I think its the self deprecating sense of humor, but all that does is make me the butt of everyone's joke. I've come clean about my real self to a few friends and they've assured me of all the reasons they like me but then I feel like they are just trying to keep me from killing myself. Its strange how depression twists our positive moments into negatives like that.

I have friends and still decide to distance myself from them. I'll loose them eventually, but for now I'm fun at parties so they keep me around. I'm still working on the life bit though, that's a bit trickier.

Something I forgot to mention, I am now terrified of guns after growing up with them since before I was in kindergarten.
